notes.title: Version 1.03 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Bugfixes:
- Fixed enemies self-inflicting damage when player spawns in a cave
- Fixed player's respawn location being wrong when dying within a cave
- Fixed enemies occasionally spawning on top of portals within Overworld
- Enemy AI will now home in on player without interfering in other enemies' paths (enemy hitboxes no longer "stick" together)

- Fixed being able to upgrade the sword and shield by bypassing resource requirements within Shop
- Fixed a possible game crash when the upgrade button is clicked upon reaching the maximum upgrade level within Shop

Changes:
- When respawning in a cave, enemies now reset health
- Increased frequency of wild enemy and traveler spawns in Overworld

- Altered volumes for certain music tracks
- Added new combat music track: 'Showdown'

- Added more traveler dialogue hints in Overworld
- Removed dependency of movement for attacking/shielding

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Added Travelers around world that will randomly appear during the day
	- Traveler NPCs will give hints to help you progress through the game
	- Caves can also occasionally spawn near travelers to explore

- Fixed enemy speeds being faster than normal in caves
- Fixed shield HP not regenerating
- Fixed mouse not showing when triggering multiple NPC dialogue boxes at once
- Fixed spawning in water
	- Player will now be pushed upwards until reaching land

- Increased regular enemy attack cooldown (1s -> 1.5s)
- Fish are now consumable, and restore 10 HP each
- Altered compass properties
	- Compass is invisible while combat is active in Eneny Outpost
	- Compass now points towards the center of the nearest structure, rather than the top-left corner


The current plan is to slowly add more content to the general map, allowing for more exciting exploration. Travelers are a step in the right direction, and over the next few updates more features and items will be rolled out to Pixeplorer. Enjoy!

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
- Fixed a potential crash when dying in an Enemy Outpost
- Fixed music randomly fading in and out at wrong times when running around overworld
- Fixed potentially spawning in the ocean when exiting a cave
- Fixed some potions having infinite uses

- Added a compass for easier world navigation

That's all for now!
